path: AddDbContext<TContext> -> AddDbContext<TContext,TContext>(..., (_, b) => optionsAction(b), ...) -> AddCoreServices -> TryAdd(ServiceDescriptor(DbContextOptions<TContext>, p => CreateDbContextOptions(p, optionsAction), optionsLifetime)) -> CreateDbContextOptions: optionsAction(sp, builder)
notes: Surprise: this is not IConfigureOptions. It is a factory registration for DbContextOptions<TContext>, and the delegate runs every time the options service is created. optionsLifetime defaults to Scoped, so it runs once per DI scope (per request in ASP.NET Core) that resolves the context. It is once per container only if optionsLifetime is Singleton, which is forced when contextLifetime is Singleton. Registration uses TryAdd, so a second AddDbContext for the same TContext keeps the first factory and silently drops the later optionsAction.
